temperature_range: 10°C to 25°C (Cool climate during vegetative growth, warm at maturity)

irrigation_schedule.stage: CRI (Crown Root Initiation / शिखर जड़ बनना)
irrigation_schedule.notes: Most critical irrigation. Missing this can cause 20-30% yield loss.
Encourages vigorous lateral shoot and tillering development.
High moisture requirement. Avoid water stagnation.
Aids grain size and starch accumulation.
Stop irrigation 10-15 days before harvest to prevent lodging.

nutrient_management.organic: Apply 8-10 tonnes/ha well-decomposed FYM (गोबर की खाद) during land preparation 3-4 weeks before sowing.
fertilizer_schedule: Basal Dose: Full Phosphorus (P₂O₅ 60 kg/ha), full Potash (K₂O 40 kg/ha), and 1/3rd Nitrogen (Urea ~50 kg/ha) at sowing.
First Top Dressing: 1/3rd Nitrogen at first irrigation (CRI stage, 21-25 DAS).
Second Top Dressing: Remaining 1/3rd Nitrogen at jointing/tillering stage (45-50 DAS).
nutrient_management.micronutrients: Zinc deficiency is common in Indo-Gangetic plains. Apply 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulphate (21%) at soil prep or foliar spray 0.5% ZnSO₄ with 0.25% lime.

common_diseases.name: Yellow / Stripe Rust (पीला रतुआ - Puccinia striiformis)
common_diseases.symptoms: Yellow powder pustules arranged in linear stripes on upper leaf surface. Dust sticks to fingers.
common_diseases.prevention: Grow rust-resistant certified varieties (e.g., HD-2967, DBW-187, DBW-222, PBW-550). Avoid late sowing.
common_diseases.treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/litre water or Tebuconazole 250 EC at first sign of disease pustules.

common_diseases.name: Loose Smut (कंगियारी / काला चूर्ण)
common_diseases.symptoms: Ears completely turn into black powdery mass of spores. Whole ear is destroyed.
common_diseases.prevention: Seed treatment with Carbendazim (Bavistin) or Carboxin @ 2-2.5 g/kg seed before sowing.
common_diseases.treatment: Rogue out infected earheads early morning in polythene bags and burn them away from field.

common_diseases.name: Karnal Bunt (करनाल बंट)
common_diseases.symptoms: Part of grain replaced by black powdery mass smelling of rotten fish (trimethylamine).
common_diseases.prevention: Use certified seed, avoid excessive nitrogenous fertilization and damp soil during heading.
common_diseases.treatment: One prophylactic spray of Propiconazole 25 EC @ 0.1% at boot leaf / heading stage.

common_pests.name: Wheat Aphids (माहू / चेपा)
common_pests.symptoms: Tiny green insects congregating on leaves and earheads, sucking sap, causing curling and stunted grains.
common_pests.management: Conserve Ladybird beetles (Coccinellids). Spray Neem oil 5ml/L or Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 ml/L if population exceeds 10 aphids/tiller.

common_pests.name: Termites (दीमक)
common_pests.symptoms: Attacks root system; drying and wilting of plants in patches, easily uprooted.
common_pests.management: Treat seeds with Chlorpyrifos 20 EC @ 4 ml/kg seed before sowing. Avoid untreated raw farmyard manure.

growth_stage_precautions.precautions: Ensure fine tilth, treat seeds with fungicide/Trichoderma, maintain optimum moisture at sowing depth (4-5 cm).
Do not delay irrigation beyond 25 DAS; light irrigation is sufficient, prevent waterlogging.
Watch for sudden rise in terminal heat in late Feb/March. Provide light irrigation on calm (wind-free) days to reduce lodging risk.
Harvest when grain moisture drops to 12-14% and ears turn golden yellow.

regional_notes: Recommended widely in Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, and Rajasthan. Always consult local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) for district-specific sowing dates and approved varieties.

temperature_range: 22°C to 35°C (Warm, humid tropical and sub-tropical conditions)
rainfall: 100 - 150 cm or assured irrigation / ponding water
soil_types: Clay Loam with high water retention

irrigation_schedule.notes: Maintain shallow water depth of 2-3 cm for easy establishment.
Maintain 3-5 cm water depth. Alternate wetting and drying (AWD) can save 20% water.
Most sensitive stage to drought. Maintain 5 cm continuous standing water.
Drain field completely 10-14 days before harvest to facilitate mechanical cutting.

nutrient_management.organic: Green manuring with Dhaincha (Sesbania) or Sunnhemp incorporated 10 days before transplanting.
fertilizer_schedule: Basal: 100% P and K + 25-33% Nitrogen at final puddling.
First Top Dressing: 33% Nitrogen at active tillering (20-25 DAT).
Second Top Dressing: Remaining Nitrogen at panicle initiation (40-45 DAT).
nutrient_management.micronutrients: Zinc deficiency causes Khaira disease (खैरा रोग). Apply 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulphate heptahydrate (21%) at final puddling or foliar spray 5kg ZnSO₄ + 2.5kg lime in 1000L water/ha.

common_diseases.name: Blast (झुलसा रोग - Pyricularia oryzae)
common_diseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped eye spots with grey/white center and brown-red margin on leaves, or rotting at node/neck of panicle (Neck blast).
common_diseases.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer. Seed treatment with Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 2 g/kg seed.
common_diseases.treatment: Foliar spray of Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40 EC @ 1.5 ml/L at first disease detection.

common_diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB - जीवाणु पत्ती झुलसा)
common_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaf tips drying into wavy greenish-yellow to bleached white straw stripes.
common_diseases.prevention: Ensure good drainage. Balance nitrogen with adequate potassium. Use resistant varieties like Swarna Sub-1, Samba Mahsuri.
common_diseases.treatment: Drain excess water. Spray Copper Oxychloride 50 WP (2.5 g/L) + Streptocycline (0.1 g/L).

common_diseases.name: Sheath Blight (शीथ ब्लाइट)
common_diseases.symptoms: Oval irregular greenish-grey spots on leaf sheaths near water line resembling snake skin.
common_diseases.prevention: Avoid thick planting and excessive urea. Clean weeds from bunds.
common_diseases.treatment: Spray Validamycin 3L @ 2 ml/L or Hexaconazole 5 EC @ 2 ml/L directed towards plant base.

common_pests.name: Yellow Stem Borer (तना छेदक)
common_pests.symptoms: Dead heart in vegetative stage (central shoot dries); white earhead (empty chaffy white panicle) at reproductive stage.
common_pests.management: Install pheromone traps @ 8-10 traps/ha. Apply Cartap Hydrochloride 4G @ 10 kg/acre or Chlorantraniliprole 0.4 GR.

common_pests.name: Brown Plant Hopper - BPH (भूरा फुदका)
common_pests.symptoms: Plants turn yellow, wilt and dry rapidly in circular patches known as 'Hopper burn'.
common_pests.management: Form 30 cm alleyways ('passing ways') every 2-3 meters. Spray Pymetrozine 50% WDG @ 0.6 g/L or Triflumezopyrim 10 SC.

growth_stage_precautions.precautions: Treat seeds with Carbendazim or Trichoderma. Keep nursery weed-free and protect against stem borer.
Transplant 20-25 day old seedlings, 2-3 per hill at 20x15 cm spacing. Ensure proper field leveling.
Never let the field go completely dry; moisture deficit at this stage severely reduces grain filling.
Harvest when 85% of panicles turn golden yellow. Dry grains to 12-14% moisture before storage.

regional_notes: Dominant across West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, and Bihar. Follow local state agricultural university recommendations for direct seeded rice (DSR) vs transplanted rice.

temperature_range: 18°C to 27°C (Temperatures above 35°C reduce pollen fertility and fruit set)
rainfall: 60 - 80 cm with regular light drip or furrow irrigation
soil_types: Well-drained Clay Loam rich in organic matter

irrigation_schedule.timing: Immediately after planting and at 3-4 days interval
irrigation_schedule.notes: Helps quick root establishment. Avoid heavy flood irrigation.
Maintain steady moisture; fluctuating moisture causes fruit cracking.
Moisture stress causes flower drops and Blossom End Rot (BER).

irrigation_schedule.timing: Light irrigation after each harvest picking
irrigation_schedule.notes: Excessive watering near picking softens fruit skin and decreases shelf life.

nutrient_management.organic: Apply 15-20 tonnes/ha well-rotted cow dung compost or vermicompost 4 tonnes/ha.
fertilizer_schedule: Basal: 100% P, 50% K, and 25% N at transplanting.
Split 1: 25% N and 25% K at 30 days after transplanting.
Split 2: 25% N and 25% K at flowering onset (45-50 DAT).
Split 3: Remaining 25% N during peak fruit development.
nutrient_management.micronutrients: Calcium deficiency causes Blossom End Rot (black sunken bottom of tomato). Foliar spray Calcium Nitrate (0.5%) + Boron (0.1%) during flowering.

common_diseases.name: Early Blight (अगेती झुलसा - Alternaria solani)
common_diseases.symptoms: Concentric rings ('target board' pattern) with dark brown or black spots on older leaves, progressing upward.
common_diseases.prevention: Crop rotation, prune lower foliage touching soil, maintain good spacing for airflow.
common_diseases.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP (2.5 g/L) or Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 1 ml/L.

common_diseases.name: Late Blight (पछेती झुलसा - Phytophthora infestans)
common_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked irregular pale green/brown patches on leaves with white fluffy fungal growth on underside in cool damp weather.
common_diseases.prevention: Avoid overhead watering; remove infected leaves immediately; avoid excessive nitrogen.
common_diseases.treatment: Prophylactic spray of Mancozeb or systemic spray of Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil MZ) @ 2.5 g/L.

common_diseases.name: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus - ToLCV (पत्ती मरोड़ रोग)
common_diseases.symptoms: Upward curling and crinkling of leaves, yellowing of veins, stunted plant growth with bushy appearance.
common_diseases.prevention: Transmitted by Whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci). Install yellow sticky traps (15-20 traps/acre). Use nylon net nurseries (40 mesh).
common_diseases.treatment: No direct cure once infected. Control whitefly vector using Acetamiprid 20 SP (0.5 g/L) or Spiromesifen 22.9 SC (1 ml/L).

common_pests.name: Tomato Fruit Borer (फल छेदक - Helicoverpa armigera)
common_pests.symptoms: Caterpillars bore into fruits making circular entry holes; fruits rot and drop prematurely.
common_pests.management: Plant African Marigold as trap crop (1 row every 16 rows of tomato). Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2 g/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4 g/L.

common_pests.name: Whitefly (सफेद मक्खी - Bemisia tabaci)
common_pests.symptoms: Tiny white winged insects under leaf surface; secrete sticky honeydew causing black sooty mold and vector viruses.
common_pests.management: Yellow sticky traps; spray Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) or Imidacloprid 17.8 SL (0.5 ml/L).

growth_stage_precautions.precautions: Raise on 15 cm raised beds, protect with insect nets, drench with Trichoderma to prevent Damping-Off.
Stake indeterminate varieties using bamboo or trellising to keep fruits off damp soil.
Ensure regular balanced irrigation; moisture dry-wet shocks cause blossom end rot and fruit splitting.
Pick fruits at 'breaker' or pink stage for distant markets; pick red ripe for immediate local consumption.

regional_notes: Widely grown in Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, Gujarat, Odisha, and Maharashtra. Soil-borne bacterial wilt is high in acidic soils — choose wilt-resistant varieties like Arka Rakshak or Arka Samrat.

sowing_period: October to November (Plains), March to April (Hills)
harvest_period: January to March (90-120 days depending on variety)
temperature_range: 15°C to 22°C (Tuber initiation stops if soil temp exceeds 30°C)
rainfall: 50 - 70 cm with well-spaced furrow or drip irrigations
soil_types: Well-drained Sandy Loam (बलुई दोमट) rich in humus
Loose, friable silt loam free from stones and clods

irrigation_schedule.notes: Ensure good moisture in soil so seeds germinate without initial flood water rotting.
Most critical stage. Light furrow irrigation. Water should not overflow ridge crest.
Maintain continuous uniform moisture. Water deficit causes knobby or cracked tubers.
Cut haulms (vines) and withhold irrigation completely to harden tuber skin.

nutrient_management.organic: Apply 25-30 tonnes/ha well-decomposed farmyard manure 3 weeks before planting.
fertilizer_schedule: Basal: Full P, full K, and half Nitrogen at planting in furrows 5 cm below seed tubers.
Top Dressing: Remaining half Nitrogen at earthing-up (मिट्टी चढ़ाना) around 30-35 DAP.
nutrient_management.micronutrients: Foliar spray of Zinc Sulphate (0.2%) + Boric Acid (0.1%) at 45 DAP promotes uniform tuber skin texture.

common_diseases.name: Late Blight of Potato (पछेती झुलसा - Phytophthora infestans)
common_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaf edges spreading rapidly; white downy mildew on underside in foggy damp mornings; tubers show brownish-purple dry rot.
common_diseases.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed tubers (Kufri Pukhraj, Kufri Jyoti, Kufri Mohan). Avoid excessive dampness.
common_diseases.treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP (2.5 g/L) as preventive spray; switch to Cymoxanil + Mancozeb (Moximate @ 2.5 g/L) or Dimethomorph (1 g/L) at first symptom.

common_diseases.name: Early Blight (अगेती झुलसा - Alternaria solani)
common_diseases.symptoms: Small brown angular spots with concentric target-board rings on leaves.
common_diseases.prevention: Rotate crops; destroy debris after harvest.
common_diseases.treatment: Foliar spray of Chlorothalonil 75 WP @ 2 g/L or Mancozeb @ 2.5 g/L.

common_diseases.name: Common Scab (खुरंड / स्कैब - Streptomyces scabies)
common_diseases.symptoms: Rough, corky, brownish raised or pitted lesions on tuber skin reducing market value.
common_diseases.prevention: Maintain soil pH around 5.5. Maintain good soil moisture during tuberization. Avoid fresh uncomposted lime or poultry manure.
common_diseases.treatment: Seed tuber treatment with Boric Acid 3% for 20-30 minutes before cold storage or before planting.

common_pests.name: Potato Tuber Moth - PTM (आलू शलभ - Phthorimaea operculella)
common_pests.symptoms: Larvae mine leaves and bore into exposed tubers in fields or in open storage, filling galleries with black frass.
common_pests.management: Ensure deep planting (10-15 cm) and thorough earthing up to keep tubers covered. Cover country store potatoes with 2.5 cm dried sand layer or Lantana leaves.

common_pests.name: Cutworms (कटवर्म / सुंडी - Agrotis ipsilon)
common_pests.symptoms: Caterpillars hide in soil by day and cut tender young plant stems at ground level at night.
common_pests.management: Deep summer plowing to expose pupae to birds; drench soil with Chlorpyrifos 20 EC @ 2.5 ml/L near plant rows.

growth_stage_precautions.precautions: Take out certified seed tubers from cold storage 10-14 days early for green sprouting (chit). Treat with Mencozeb 2.5 g/L.
Perform earthing up 25-30 DAP. Tubers exposed to sunlight turn green and toxic (solanine production).
Cut top vines 10-12 days prior to digging. This hardens tuber skin and prevents skin peeling during harvest.
Dry harvested tubers in shade for 7-10 days before packing into gunny bags. Do not expose to direct harsh sun.

regional_notes: Key production centers in Uttar Pradesh (Agra, Aligarh, Farrukhabad), West Bengal, Bihar, Punjab, and Gujarat. Check regional advisories from Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI, Shimla).
